# Legend

> Legend constructor.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Legend = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/legend/ctor' );
```

#### Legend( options )

Returns a legend instance.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});
// returns <Legend>
```

The constructor accepts the following `options`:

-   **aria**: boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG output. Default: `true`.
-   **clipHeight**: height (in pixels) to clip symbol legend entries and limit their size.
-   **columnPadding**: horizontal padding (in pixels) between symbol legend columns.
-   **columns**: number of columns in which to arrange symbol legend entries.
-   **cornerRadius**: corner radius for the full legend.
-   **description**: legend description. Default: `''`.
-   **direction**: direction of the legend. Default: `'vertical'`.
-   **encode**: mark encodings for custom legend styling.
-   **fill**: name of the scale that maps to a fill color.
-   **fillColor**: background fill color for the full legend.
-   **format**: format specifier for legend labels.
-   **formatType**: type of format to use for legend scales which do not have a strict domain data type.
-   **gradientLength**: length (in pixels) of the primary axis of a color gradient.
-   **gradientOpacity**: opacity of the color gradient.
-   **gradientStrokeColor**: stroke color of the color gradient border.
-   **gradientStrokeWidth**: stroke width of the color gradient border.
-   **gradientThickness**: thickness (in pixels) of the color gradient.
-   **gridAlign**: grid alignment for legend entries. Default: `'each'`.
-   **labelAlign**: horizontal text alignment of legend labels.
-   **labelBaseline**: vertical text baseline of legend labels.
-   **labelColor**: text color for legend labels.
-   **labelFont**: font name for legend labels.
-   **labelFontSize**: font size (in pixels) of legend labels.
-   **labelFontStyle**: font style of legend labels.
-   **labelFontWeight**: font weight of legend labels.
-   **labelLimit**: maximum allowed length (in pixels) of legend labels.
-   **labelOffset**: offset (in pixels) between legend labels and their corresponding symbol or gradient.
-   **labelOpacity**: opacity of legend labels.
-   **labelOverlap**: strategy for resolving overlapping legend labels in gradient legends. Default: `true`.
-   **labelSeparation**: minimum separation between legend label bounding boxes for them to be considered non-overlapping. Default: `0`.
-   **legendX**: custom `x` position (in pixels) for the legend group.
-   **legendY**: custom `y` position (in pixels) for the legend group.
-   **offset**: offset (in pixels) by which to displace the legend from the data rectangle and axes.
-   **opacity**: name of the scale that maps to an opacity value.
-   **orient**: legend orientation. Default: `'right'`.
-   **padding**: padding (in pixels) between legend border and content of the legend group.
-   **rowPadding**: vertical padding (in pixels) between symbol legend entries.
-   **shape**: name of the scale that maps to a shape value.
-   **size**: name of the scale that maps to a size value.
-   **stroke**: name of the scale that maps to a stroke color.
-   **strokeColor**: border stroke color for the full legend.
-   **strokeDash**: name of the scale that maps to a stroke dash value.
-   **strokeWidth**: name of the scale that maps to a stroke width value.
-   **symbolDash**: stroke dash for symbol outlines. Default: `[]`.
-   **symbolDashOffset**: pixel offset at which to start the symbol stroke dash array.
-   **symbolFillColor**: fill color of legend symbols.
-   **symbolLimit**: maximum number of entries for a symbol legend.
-   **symbolOffset**: horizontal pixel offset for legend symbols.
-   **symbolOpacity**: opacity of legend symbols.
-   **symbolSize**: default symbol area size (in squared pixels).
-   **symbolStrokeColor**: stroke color of legend symbols.
-   **symbolStrokeWidth**: default stroke width of legend symbols.
-   **symbolType**: default symbol shape type for legend entries.
-   **tickCount**: desired number of tick values for quantitative legends.
-   **tickMinStep**: minimum desired step between tick values (in the same units as scale domain values).
-   **title**: legend title.
-   **titleAlign**: horizontal text alignment of the legend title.
-   **titleAnchor**: legend title anchor position. Default: `null`.
-   **titleBaseline**: vertical text baseline of the legend title.
-   **titleColor**: text color of the legend title.
-   **titleFont**: font name of the legend title.
-   **titleFontSize**: font size of the legend title.
-   **titleFontStyle**: font style of the legend title.
-   **titleFontWeight**: font weight of the legend title.
-   **titleLimit**: maximum allowed length (in pixels) of the legend title.
-   **titleLineHeight**: line height (in pixels) for multi-line title text.
-   **titleOpacity**: opacity of the legend title.
-   **titleOrient**: orientation of the legend title. Default: `'top'`.
-   **titlePadding**: padding (in pixels) between the legend title and entries.
-   **type**: legend type.
-   **values**: explicit set of legend values.
-   **zindex**: integer z-index indicating the layering of the legend group relative to other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: `0`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale',
    'title': 'Legend Title'
});
// returns <Legend>

var v = legend.title;
// returns [ 'Legend Title' ]
```

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-aria"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.aria

Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG output. Default: `true`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.aria = false;

// Get:
var v = legend.aria;
// returns false
```

<a name="prop-clip-height"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.clipHeight

Height (in pixels) to clip symbol legend entries and limit their size.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.clipHeight = 20;

// Get:
var v = legend.clipHeight;
// returns 20
```

<a name="prop-column-padding"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.columnPadding

Horizontal padding (in pixels) between symbol legend columns.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.columnPadding = 10;

// Get:
var v = legend.columnPadding;
// returns 10
```

<a name="prop-columns"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.columns

Number of columns in which to arrange symbol legend entries.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.columns = 2;

// Get:
var v = legend.columns;
// returns 2
```

<a name="prop-corner-radius"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.cornerRadius

Corner radius for the full legend.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.cornerRadius = 3;

// Get:
var v = legend.cornerRadius;
// returns 3
```

<a name="prop-description"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.description

Legend description. Default: `''`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.description = 'Color legend';

// Get:
var v = legend.description;
// returns 'Color legend'
```

<a name="prop-direction"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.direction

Direction of the legend. Default: `'vertical'`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.direction = 'horizontal';

// Get:
var v = legend.direction;
// returns 'horizontal'
```

<a name="prop-encode"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.encode

Mark encodings for custom legend styling.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.encode = {
    'labels': {
        'update': {
            'fill': {
                'value': 'steelblue'
            }
        }
    }
};

// Get:
var v = legend.encode;
// returns {...}
```

```javascript
var v = legend.titleFontWeight;
// returns 'bold'
```

<a name="prop-title-limit"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.titleLimit

Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of the legend title.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.titleLimit = 100;

// Get:
var v = legend.titleLimit;
// returns 100
```

<a name="prop-title-line-height"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.titleLineHeight

Line height (in pixels) for multi-line title text.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.titleLineHeight = 16;

// Get:
var v = legend.titleLineHeight;
// returns 16
```

<a name="prop-title-opacity"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.titleOpacity

Opacity of the legend title.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.titleOpacity = 0.8;

// Get:
var v = legend.titleOpacity;
// returns 0.8
```

<a name="prop-title-orient"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.titleOrient

Orientation of the legend title. Default: `'top'`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.titleOrient = 'left';

// Get:
var v = legend.titleOrient;
// returns 'left'
```

<a name="prop-title-padding"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.titlePadding

Padding (in pixels) between the legend title and entries.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.titlePadding = 8;

// Get:
var v = legend.titlePadding;
// returns 8
```

<a name="prop-type"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.type

Legend type.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.type = 'gradient';

// Get:
var v = legend.type;
// returns 'gradient'
```

<a name="prop-values"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.values

Explicit set of legend values.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.values = [ 1, 2, 3 ];

// Get:
var v = legend.values;
// returns [ 1, 2, 3 ]
```

<a name="prop-zindex"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.zindex

Integer z-index indicating the layering of the legend group relative to other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: `0`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

// Set:
legend.zindex = 2;

// Get:
var v = legend.zindex;
// returns 2
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

var v = legend.properties;
// returns [ 'aria', 'clipHeight', 'columnPadding', 'columns', 'cornerRadius', 'description', 'direction', 'encode', 'fill', 'fillColor', 'format', 'formatType', 'gradientLength', 'gradientOpacity', 'gradientStrokeColor', 'gradientStrokeWidth', 'gradientThickness', 'gridAlign', 'labelAlign', 'labelBaseline', 'labelColor', 'labelFont', 'labelFontSize', 'labelFontStyle', 'labelFontWeight', 'labelLimit', 'labelOffset', 'labelOpacity', 'labelOverlap', 'labelSeparation', 'legendX', 'legendY', 'offset', 'opacity', 'orient', 'padding', 'rowPadding', 'shape', 'size', 'stroke', 'strokeColor', 'strokeDash', 'strokeWidth', 'symbolDash', 'symbolDashOffset', 'symbolFillColor', 'symbolLimit', 'symbolOffset', 'symbolOpacity', 'symbolSize', 'symbolStrokeColor', 'symbolStrokeWidth', 'symbolType', 'tickCount', 'tickMinStep', 'title', 'titleAlign', 'titleAnchor', 'titleBaseline', 'titleColor', 'titleFont', 'titleFontSize', 'titleFontStyle', 'titleFontWeight', 'titleLimit', 'titleLineHeight', 'titleOpacity', 'titleOrient', 'titlePadding', 'type', 'values', 'zindex' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Legend.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes a legend instance to a JSON object.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

var v = legend.toJSON();
// returns { 'aria': true, 'description': '', 'direction': 'vertical', 'fill': 'colorScale', 'gridAlign': 'each', 'labelOverlap': true, 'labelSeparation': 0, 'orient': 'right', 'symbolDash': [], 'titleAnchor': null, 'titleOrient': 'top', 'zindex': 0 }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

var str = JSON.stringify( legend );
// returns '{"aria":true,"description":"","direction":"vertical","fill":"colorScale","gridAlign":"each","labelOverlap":true,"labelSeparation":0,"orient":"right","symbolDash":[],"titleAnchor":null,"titleOrient":"top","zindex":0}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var legend = new Legend({
    'fill': 'colorScale'
});

legend.on( 'change', onChange );

legend.title = 'Legend Title';

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```
